subtasks.description: Define ingestion/processing/evaluation/review coverage as separate counters and build stratified/random/risk-triggered sampling.
Create supervisor review queues with assignment, due time and record-level authorization.
Add criterion override with reason/evidence, preserving machine and human scores separately.
Add blinded calibration batches and reviewer agreement reporting against adjudicated examples.
Implement agent appeal, supervisor disposition and audit history with clear notifications.
Create specific coaching tasks from accepted findings, with owner, due date, acknowledgement and follow-up review.
Validate matched-task review time and agent/supervisor usability; prevent cohort/rubric mixing in comparisons.
